newsitem.title: USA: UC Television names new CEO and president.
newsitem.headline: UC Television names new CEO and president.

text.p: UC Television Network Corp said Tuesday its board appointed Jason Elkin as chairman and chief executive officer, effective May 12, and appointed John Dobson president.
Elkin had been chairman and chief executive of New Vision Television, a group of independent television stations, before joining UC Television, the company said.
Dobson was vice president at Turner Broadcasting Sales in charge of national and regional advertising for Turner's Atlanta market, the company said.

The company also said Peter Kauff, its former chief executive, has been named chief operating officer and that Joseph Gersh, who was chief operating officer of New Vision Television, has been named vice chairman at UC Television.
UC Television is an interactive multimedia company developing, producing and marketing interactive entertainment products.
